source_text: Non facies tibi sculptile. Deus invisibilis non in materia fingendus. Imago vera — Christus; conformamini imagini eius.
pass_a_gloss: Not you-shall-make to-you carved-thing. God invisible not in matter to-be-fashioned. Image true — Christ; be-conformed to-image his.
pass_b_english: [[You shall not make for yourself a graven image >> Bible:Exodus 20:4]]. The invisible God is not to be fashioned in matter. The true image is Christ; [[be conformed to his image >> Bible:Romans 8:29]].
